proposals.rationale: Moved Br from meta to para on anilino ring to probe steric/electronic tolerance of EGFR hydrophobic pocket.
Bromine to chlorine bioisosteric halogen swap, reducing molecular weight/lipophilicity while retaining halogen bonding.
Replaced Br with nitrile to maintain similar electronic character while adding H-bond acceptor capability, common EGFR anilinoquinazoline modification.
Extended one methoxy to a methoxyethoxy chain (erlotinib-like side chain) to improve solubility and mimic known EGFR inhibitor SAR.
Introduced morpholine-ethoxy side chain at one methoxy position to boost aqueous solubility and modulate selectivity via extended solvent-exposed substituent.
Replaced one methoxy with amino group to probe altered H-bonding/electronics at the 6-position while keeping core scaffold.
Swapped one methoxy for fluorine, a smaller bioisostere, to reduce steric bulk and modulate electron density on the quinazoline ring.
Replaced quinazoline CH at position 2 with an amino-substituted pyrimidine-like nitrogen pattern to probe hinge-binding H-bond donor addition.
Replaced one methoxy with a difluoromethoxy group to modulate electronics and metabolic stability while keeping similar steric profile.
Introduced an additional ring nitrogen (pyridopyrimidine-type core) to probe altered hinge-binding geometry and selectivity.
